ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Weather Suite (Ash'karr)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Wires `mandrake.rsw.weathersuite`'s generic terminator-band/nightside-band engine onto THIS campaign's real, frozen planet: ships the one PlanetGeometryDef with Ash'karr's actual substellar point (lat 0, lon 0) and its actual band arcs (63-117 for the terminator storm wall, reusing the exact arc range already used to site the Twilight Sea and Grey Sea; 117+ for the dark-side aurora's nightside band), plus folk-sign flavor text on a handful of existing WeatherDefs. WEATHER_SUITE_SLICE_1's v1 slice, per `infrastructure/state/items/WEATHER_SUITE_SLICE_1.md`.
